old_question.question: Thunderspeaker has met both a threshold making one of its Innates Fast and a threshold that can affect game state. Is the Speed-changing threshold applied only at its printed position after the lower effects, or before checking the phase in which that Innate can be used?

new_question.question: Thunderspeaker has met both a threshold making one of its Innates Fast and a threshold that can affect game state. Is the Speed-changing threshold handled only as an ordinary effect when resolving that Innate, or applied before checking the phase in which the Innate can be used?

old_key.answer: Check and apply the Speed-changing threshold when checking the Power's Speed, before its ordinary effects. With those thresholds met, the Innate may be used Fast. The printed lower-effect order does not postpone its Speed change until after using a Slow Power.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: When the Fast threshold is applied
required_facts: Apply the Speed-changing threshold when checking the Innate's Speed/phase, before its ordinary effects rather than postponing it until its printed position.

key_context_not_required.fact: The met Fast threshold allows Fast use in this case.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: This follows directly from applying the stipulated threshold at the phase check; do not require another recital of the given threshold or Elements.

key_context_not_required.fact: Later Elements cannot retroactively legalize earlier targets or phases.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The refined question omits this already-tested Q27 subject.

reason: The stem says "its printed position after the lower effects". Both native Thunderspeaker Innates put the4-Air Fast threshold ABOVE the state-changing thresholds. The alternative therefore inaccurately implies a printed position.
